<<<SOLUTION_CODE>>>
const data = require('node:fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);

const n = data[0] ?? 0;
const m = data[1] ?? 0;
const lines = [];

for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
  const row = [];
  for (let j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
    row.push(String(i * j));
  }
  lines.push(row.join(' '));
}

process.stdout.write(lines.join('\n'));
<<<MAKER_TS>>>
import { defineDataset, fmt } from 'genesis-kit';

type Input = {
  n: number;
  m: number;
};

function isInt(value: number): boolean {
  return Number.isInteger(value);
}

export default defineDataset<Input>({
  solution: 'std.js',
  seed: 'ai-regression-arithmetic-matrix',
  format: ({ n, m }) => fmt.line(n, m),
  validate: ({ n, m }) => {
    if (!isInt(n) || !isInt(m)) return 'n and m must be integers';
    if (n < 1 || n > 50) return 'n must be in [1, 50]';
    if (m < 1 || m > 50) return 'm must be in [1, 50]';
    return true;
  },
  cases: [
    { name: 'sample', tags: ['sample'], input: { n: 3, m: 4 } },
    { name: 'single-cell', tags: ['edge'], input: { n: 1, m: 1 } },
    { name: 'single-row', tags: ['shape'], input: { n: 1, m: 7 } },
    { name: 'single-column', tags: ['shape'], input: { n: 8, m: 1 } },
    { name: 'square-small', tags: ['square'], input: { n: 5, m: 5 } },
    { name: 'max-rectangle', tags: ['max'], input: { n: 50, m: 50 } },
  ],
});
